infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Eastwind can send one line a morning, at an hour you choose. Reminders are scheduled on your phone; nothing is sent anywhere.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Eastwind only opens your photo library when you choose a photo for dating-profile notes. The photo is sent once to our server for the notes and is not stored.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Eastwind can take a photo for dating-profile notes if you choose to. It is sent once for the notes and is not stored.

plugins.photosPermission: Eastwind only opens your photo library when you choose a photo for dating-profile notes.
plugins.cameraPermission: Eastwind can take a photo for dating-profile notes if you choose to.
